text:
incidents-bot: PAGER — billing-metering detected token-count drift for customer `acme-corp` (possible duplicate emits). Severity: P2. Runbook: #metering-pager. https://ops.redwood/incident/1715009990

sara (oncall): ack — I'm on it, will triage.

mike: seeing a spike in emitted tokens for the last 30m, looks correlated with kafka consumer lag on emitter-3.

nina: customer ops FYI — acme reported an unexpected overage alert ~14:03 UTC. Waiting on impact assessment.

samir: logs from emitter-3: ```
WARN metering.emitter PartitionProcessor[3] duplicate_message_detected key=usr-123 delta_tokens=1027 offset=9854321
INFO metering.emitter EmitBatch size=500 latency_ms=12 source=kafka-partition-3
```

billing-eng: quick check — shadow tally shows +20k tokens vs ledger for acme in the 14:00-14:30 window. Not all attributed yet.

sara (oncall): immediate mitigation: scaling down emitter-3 to 0.5x, pausing consumer retries and enabling dedupe filter v2. Rolling out now.

mike: applied pause to consumer group `metering-emitter-3-retries` and toggled dedupe=true on staging path, testing keys.

incidents-bot: REDEPLOY — dedupe-filter v2 rolled to emitter-3 (rev r204). Link: https://ci/changes/r204

nina: acme contacted support. They received an overage email at 14:07. We should consider auto-crediting if counts reduce after rollback.

sara (oncall): performing live reconciliation: running `./scripts/recon_tokens --customer acme-corp --window 2026-03-18T14:00Z/2026-03-18T14:30Z` — will post result.

samir: recon output (partial): ```
observed_emits=20567
ledger_count=38
delta=20529
most_emits_from=emitter-3 partition=3
```

billing-eng: that delta looks like duplicated batch re-emits, likely due to retry loop plus missing dedupe header.

sara (oncall): next steps: 1) keep dedupe v2 live, 2) backfill ledger with corrected counts where delta>0 after recon, 3) prepare customer credit proposal. Assigning billing-eng to backfill.

product-ops: please draft a short customer note explaining root cause and mitigation; include ETA for credits.

billing-eng: starting backfill job `backfill-1715009990` now, will monitor for side-effects.

incidents-bot: UPDATE — Pager escalated to P1 if customer-visible overages > $5000 or >5 customers affected. Current impact: 1 customer (acme), estimated exposure ~$320.

nina: acme responded: "Thanks, please confirm credits and that this won't recur." Sent initial ack.

sara (oncall): monitoring metrics — token emission rate returned to baseline after dedupe roll (14:12 UTC). Reconciliation still running.

mike: noting: kafka consumer lag metric `consumer_lag_emitter_3` peaked at 12000 msgs at 13:58, root cause appears to be a transient hotspot on node i-08a.

samir: filed infra ticket #INF-492 to investigate node hot restart behavior; not blocking incident mitigation.

billing-eng: backfill completed — adjusted ledger by -20529 tokens for acme; generated credit draft for product-ops.

product-ops: drafted message and credit — will send after legal review.

sara (oncall): marking incident as mitigated at 14:40 UTC. Recommend postmortem to include: emitter retry semantics, dedupe header enforcement, and consumer lag alert tuning.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — P2 -> mitigated. Close when postmortem created.

mike: +1 on postmortem. I'll own infra section. billing-eng take billing section. nina to coordinate customer comms.

nina: sending final note to acme now. :white_check_mark:
